QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] The Flying Whale
QuestInfo.0: What's a Supply Merchant doing here, and what does he need? Talk to #p9073024# to find out more.
QuestInfo.1: Turns out, #p9073024# is a Silent Crusader, and one of some repute, to boot! He needs you to investigate the #p9073008# that's appeared in #r#m270010500##k in the Temple of Time.\r\n\r\n- #rDefeat at least 1 #o9300517##k -

0.0: Now, you're probably wondering how I can tell that you're suited for this, right?\r\n#L0##bSure, I guess I'm curious.#l\n#k
0.1: #p9073005# once asked me the very same thing, and I'll tell you what I told him: I just get a hunch about these things. \r\n#L0##bWait, does that mean you were once part of the Silent Crusade?#l\n#k
0.2: Sure was. Just think of me as part of an older generation of Silent Crusaders. I was a part of the group back when #p9073005# was younger than #p9073022#. Not to brag, but people used to call me an legend...\r\n#L0##bI don't know whether you're just showing off or if you're serious.#l\n#k
0.3: The important thing here is whether you're going to accept the job. So, you in?

yes.0: Excellent! Investigate the #p9073008# that appeared in #r#m270010500##k and defeat the #b#o9300517##k inside. I'll fill you in on the rest of the job when you return.

no.0: The Silent Crusade since my heyday has become such a disgrace.

1.0: I knew you could do the job. Nice work. Now, you ready to hear what's next?\r\n#L0##bOh great, is there more?#l\n#k
1.1: Just listen. Ever since the goddess Rhinne was sealed, time has been distorted. Strange monsters have started to appear in the Temple of Time. You just defeated one of the three most powerful amongst them. \r\n#L0##bUgh, don't tell me I need to fight the other two now...#l\n#k
1.2: Well, aren't you a clever one? That's exactly what you need to do! Powerful monsters tend to hid inside the #p9073008#s, and the three new gates we found are all in the areas where the most powerful monsters reside.

yes.0: All right, it's time to tackle the next gate. Let me know when you're ready.

mob.0: If this job were easy, they wouldn't have called ME in. You're going to have to try harder.
